tiny_case_classifications.mixed-disjoint-1000: Primary elapsed paired median +5.72% and CPU +6.07%; fixed follow-up +2.12% elapsed and +1.76% CPU, with broad signed spreads in both phases. No repeated above5% median regression; retain the primary trigger and classify direction as inconclusive.

method_limits: Elapsed includes process launch, input/output and completion; CPU and RSS come from wait4 for the exact child.
Split-family observations sum elapsed/CPU and use maximum constituent-process RSS, not combined simultaneous RSS.
Small-input wait4 peak RSS can include a pre-exec parent high-water floor. Identical roughly21.7-23.0MiB B/C values in the1,000-entry control do not establish equal CLI allocations.
No sample was removed or pooled. The required fixed follow-up is separate, and individual above5% observations remain recorded.
Native ARM64 Linux runs through OrbStack; these results do not establish bare-metal Linux behavior.
